ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL) will participate in the Nuvama Emerging India CEO Forum on September 28, 2026, engaging physically with investors and analysts using its previously submitted Q1FY27 earnings presentation. This is a standard investor relations activity to maintain transparency and facilitate communication, explicitly stating no new Unpublished Price Sensitive Information will be disclosed. Consequently, this intimation presents no immediate material market impacts or red flags, representing a routine regulatory filing for investor outreach.
